summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; login/extra.client_id and password/extra.client_secret fallbacks; profile sets auth_type oauth and environment-variable references for both secrets). Registered it directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings, and added it to the exports in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection from extra credentials, profile output, auth/secret overrides, and env vars. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed.
